acceptance_criteria.description: The fresh run retains the exact Terminal-Bench commit, Harbor executable digest, Docker image ID and manifest digest, and resolved manifest digest.
The unchanged regex-log verifier produces digest-bound ctrf.json and test-stdout.txt in a fresh durable record root.
Native reward zero with valid completion evidence is persisted as verified_fail, never verifier_error or an Agent score.
The persisted report, record index, artifacts, and standalone verifier all pass from retained bytes.

objective: After tb-container-verifier-bootstrap merges, run the unchanged regex-log official verifier with the no-provider subject in a fresh durable record root, independently verify retained CTRF/stdout/Harbor evidence, and classify reward zero as verified_fail rather than verifier_error.
title: Verify Terminal-Bench verifier bootstrap in a fresh Docker run
